material_input_classification.input: synthetic features, clocks, splits, deterministic policies, metrics, replay, and mutations
real incumbent workflow, replacement threshold, risk tolerance, complexity budget, and deployment policy
real point-in-time source features and mature F9 labels
predictive validity, calibration, subgroup behavior, incremental lift, and commercial value
sealed baseline attacks and external hidden model holdout

hard_boundaries: Every policy must route through the frozen MATH exact-ten-or-abstain decision contract.
Only Stage-1 information available by the decision cutoff may influence ranking.
All policies use the identical candidate universe, splits, label eligibility, and metrics.
Immature, censored, competing, conflicted, and unknown labels are never negatives.
Synthetic comparison cannot establish real predictive validity, lift, value, or production superiority.
Live ranking, source access, and outreach remain disabled.
